ai_summary: Two inference stacks. (1) FaceUnity Nama/FuAI 8.2.0: libCNamaSDK.so (renderer + bundle loader) and libfuai.so (vendored TensorFlow Lite with FUAI_* model API) run 33 TFLite models shipped inside 22 custom `.bundle` containers (ZIP archives obfuscated with a XOR key and a 1024-byte keyed prologue) for face detection/landmarks, face parsing/beauty, del-spot, teeth seg, skin seg, age/gender, bindi seg, body keypoints, scene recognition and makeup. (2) Mi stack: libinpaint.so/libvis.so (NNF inpainting), libaiedit.so (MNN), libmotion_photo_mace.so (MACE) with external weights, and ML Kit bundled language ID (tflite_langid.tflite.jpg, NGramHash + KmeansEmbeddingLookup custom ops).

features.name: face detection and landmark regression (91/98/154 points)
face beauty (parsing, even skin, del-spot, teeth, skin mask)
pipeline: SPADE 256x256 generators for even-skin and flaw removal (Tanh output)
del-spot: 4 classifiers 24x24 (hair/lines/highlight/acne_mole) + mole_seg 24x24x1, protected masks *_0815A.data / face_mask_mapper_skin_mask.data

features.name: body reshape / body slim
pipeline: FULLBODY_POFH2D 288x384x3 uint8 -> heatmaps 25kp 72x96, bdycntr 67 joints, POF offsets 48x64x78, BBF 6x8x192
skeleton/rigid solve in libfuai (FUAI_HumanSkeleton*), mesh warp in GL

features.name: scene recognition / scene-aware beauty
pipeline: MobileOne S2 size384 FP16 classifier (MOBILEONE_S2_SIZE384_EXP30_DATA7.0.0_FP16.tflite, zip entry encrypted-prologue only)
scene id selects GLSL beauty preset

features.name: makeup (texture layers)
pipeline: blend in GL with face UV from landmarks

features.name: object removal / inpainting
pipeline: libvis NNF inference (model path supplied by plugin, not in APK)

features.name: language identification
pipeline: per n in 1..4 hash every n-gram with MurmurHash64A(seed=10911) % vocab + 1
concat 96 -> FC160 ReLU -> FC200 ReLU -> FC111 -> softmax

models.verification: PASS: JAX vs NumPy max|d|=1.3e-06, 27/28 multilingual top-1 (reimpl/verify.txt)

reimplementation.run_command: python reimpl/verify.py && python reimpl/model.py 'Bonjour tout le monde'
reimplementation.limitations: langid: verified numerically vs an independent NumPy implementation (max|d|=1.3e-06) and end-to-end 27/28 on 28 languages; bundle models: 6 of 7 converted models match the LiteRT reference interpreter within 1e-4, Fprs parsing model drifts (1.76e-01) due to quantized-graph emulation; the first 1024 bytes of each .bundle (and hence the first ZIP entry of each bundle) stay encrypted because BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key is never initialised in the APK.

unknowns: U1 value of CNamaSDK::BundleHelper::_obfuscation_key (never written in libCNamaSDK.so; only 7 GOT-relative reads and an empty-string static init) - blocks the 1024-byte prologue and with it 48 of 726 bundle entries: config.json of the landmark/beauty-type/scene bundles and the offset-0 models acne_mole_acnenet_1206_3x24x24_quat, age_gender160_0422, bindi_seg_tiny_2024_0924, Bdycntr.0406.Exp387c.x3e210_quan1 and MOBILEONE_S2_SIZE384_EXP30_DATA7.0.0_FP16
U2 exact scheme of BundleHelper::VerifySignature (0x5707e4, no mbedTLS calls) and content of the 64-byte ZIP EOCD comment

U3 CORRECTED (2026-10-24): com.miui.mediaeditor.algo.* IS defined in the APK (2,664 com.miui.mediaeditor classes; e.g. algo.beauty.face.FaceBeautyAlgorithm, algo.beauty.common.core.render.GlTexturePhotoRenderer, algo.beauty.common.BeautyBaseManager). The FaceUnity SDK classes are obfuscated (j2.c/j2.d/k2.a/f2.b/m2.a/gltexturerender.d), not absent. Still absent: the makeup-style selector (no Makeup* class) and any caller of XmsContext.setupBeauty - see U7/U8
U4 inpaint (libvis NNF), libaiedit (MNN) and motion-photo (MACE) weights are external files, so their I/O contracts are unknown
U5 which TFLite delegate (GPU/Hexagon/XNNPACK) is actually used per device
U6 why the Fprs face-parsing JAX conversion drifts (quantized graph emulation)

U7 which Java class selects makeup/item_bundle/<style>.bundle and binds it (no Makeup* class in either dex; the photo UI only exposes image_threed/image_red* sliders). The item contract itself (makeup_config.json + script.js + PNG layers) is fully recovered

U8 no in-APK caller of XmsContext.setupBeauty(soPath,bundlePath,cachePath,flag): the video beauty path (BeautyWapper in libMiVideoSDK.so, filter 'movit.filter.face.beauty') is an SDK capability; the host app wiring is outside this APK

U9 float input normalization for the FuAI parser/skin/teeth nets (no mean/std fields in config.json; libfuai exposes a mean_stddev_normalization key). Blocks a bit-exact JAX reimplementation of Fprs beyond the current 1.76e-01 drift
U10 FaceUnity GPU-vs-CPU delegate selection at runtime (per-model tflite_use_gpu with device gating; fallback branch inside libfuai not observed)

data_pipelines.name: Photo editor: decode -> FuAI/CNamaSDK -> TFLite -> GL render -> save

transport.input: android.graphics.Bitmap (ARGB_8888; RGBA_F16 downcast; EXIF 3/6/8 rotated 180/90/270) or NV21 byte[]
transport.nv21_layout: Y plane w*h, then V at even offsets and U at odd (FURenderBridge.b); stride == width; w,h padded to even in gltexturerender.d.k
transport.threads: GLSurfaceView render thread for all fu* calls; HandlerThread('KIT_...') per controller; single-thread ExecutorService for save

preprocess: 3. fuImageBeautyPreProcess(format, tex=0, w, h, buf, stride=w, null,0, null,0, items, isGpu=1, isNewImage, processMode, scale=-1f) via FURenderBridge.h

4. engine-side per-model crop: config.json image_w/h/channels, mean_shape alignment (75 pts in 512x512 / 384x384 / 512x512 frames), netin_image_expand_udlr_ratio, landmark subsets (teeth kps75 46..63; bindi 28 ids), detect_rotation_crop=false
5. normalize: float32 tensors for parser/skin/teeth (internal QUANTIZE ops), uint8 for body keypoint; mean_stddev_normalization key exists in libfuai but value unknown

model_invocation.runtime: FuAI 8.2.0 (vendored TensorFlow Lite, libfuai.so); faai/model/tflite/tflite_model.cc + tflite_model_preprocess.cc
model_invocation.selection: algo.beauty.face.a.c(): graphics/image_beauty_facebeauty.bundle (GL) + model/ai_beauty_type_processor.bundle (FUAITYPE_FACEPROCESSOR_IMAGE_BEAUTY) + model/ai_face_beauty_processor.bundle (FUAITYPE_IMAGE_BEAUTY) + model/ai_face_bindi_seg_processor.bundle (FUAITYPE_FACEPROCESSOR_BINDI_SEG_PROCESSOR) + optional ai_wrinkle_remover_processor.bundle from getDir('libs')
model_invocation.loading: k2.a.e(path,type,cb): fuIsAIModelLoaded(type) -> fuLoadAIModelFromPackage(bundleZipBytes,type); items via f2.b.a(path) -> fuSetInputCameraBufferMatrixState(1) -> fuCreateItemFromPackage(bytes)
model_invocation.session_params: config.json tflite_model_param: tflite_name, threads, tflite_use_xnnpack, tflite_use_gpu + tflite_gpu_param{tflite_model_token,max_queue_count=8,tflite_gpu_use_serialization,tflite_init_create_gpu_close,tflite_release_tmp_memory}, tflite_use_dsp
model_invocation.tensor_binding: Java binds only the image buffer (fuImageBeautyPreProcess / fuImageBeautyPreview / fuImageBeautyGetResultBitmap); per-tensor binding is inside libfuai using the config.json netin_/netout_ blocks

postprocess: del-spot: 4 x 24x24x3->2 classifiers + mole_seg 24x24->24x24x1; diff_thresh 0.48, protected_mask_thresh 110, unit_rad_scale 35, expend_corner 1.2, scale_size 0.25
teeth: 192x256x4, teeth_mask_order 3, region from kps75 46..63, expand 0.25
mask->image via 80-vertex UV mesh (face_mask_mapper_face_mask.json, 136 tris) + 540x960 uint8 skin prior with 12-byte {w,h,c} header
landmark indexing for reshape via face_warp.json (283 verts / 528 tris; eye 113/86; mouth 106/44; face_uv_zz/bz 166 verts; eye_offset/chin_offset bases)
GPU warp: RGBA8 displacement map decoded as (r-127/255, (g-0.5)*2) and (b-127/255, (a-0.5)*2), applied as UV offset * intensity * scale * block_scale after rotation (image_chin_warp_fs.glsl)
per-face state persisted as image_face_data JSON {p_rect,p_do_face_beauty,p_bdyscores,p_jointscores,p_pofdirpoints,p_pofdirscores}

output.preview: texture id from fuImageBeautyPreview(items) drawn by n2.b shader in BaseGLTextureRenderer.b()
output.export: gltexturerender.c.run -> FURenderBridge.d -> fuImageBeautyGetResultBitmap(w,h,items) -> CacheData(IMAGE) -> BeautyExportDataResult.d.f7421c = Bitmap.copy(ARGB_8888,true) -> editor save (com.miui.gallery.editor.photo.app.saver.SaveParam)
output.confidence: confirmed (up to Bitmap); file write inferred

lifecycle.init: BeautyBaseManager.b(): fuSetMaxFaces(5), fuSetHumanProcessorSetMaxHumans(1), fuSetFaceProcessorDetectMode(IMAGE), fuImageBeautySetAttributePath, fuImageBeautySetFaceBeautyPath, FURenderKit.e(sdkImageCache); AtomicBoolean guard
lifecycle.per_image: one preprocess + one preview render + one result read per user action; no per-frame loop
lifecycle.teardown: BeautyBaseManager.d(): k2.a.d.a().g() (release all AI models), editor impl a() (fuReleaseGLResources/fuDone/fuOnDeviceLost), destroy items
lifecycle.fallback: fuIsAIModelLoaded short-circuit; load errors 10001/10002 with fuGetSystemError; missing dynamic-feature bundle -> download prompt (photo_editor_common_download_failed_msg)

data_pipelines.name: Video editor / transcode: MediaCodec frames -> MLT graph -> dlopen'd FaceUnity beauty -> encoder

trigger.caller_in_apk: none (definition only) - the app-level video UI (com.miui.mediaeditor.video.*) never calls it

transport.decode: libMiVideoSDK.so: NDK AMediaCodec (createDecoderByType/dequeueOutputBuffer/createInputSurface) plus bundled libhevc software HEVC decoder (external/libhevc/decoder/ihevcd_*.c); frames pulled via FrameRetriever.nativeGetNextFrame @0x108840 / nativeGetNextFrameData @0x108914; MLT/Movit GL graph
transport.beauty_input: BeautyWapper::render(int,void*,int,void*,int,int,int,int*,int,int,int,void*) - texture/ptr + dims + params array + output ptr

preprocess: FaceUnity library is not linked: BeautyWapper dlopens soPath and resolves a 5-entry function table (setupFunc, setParamdFunc, setParamsFunc, renderFunc, destoryFunc) logged as 'BeautyWapper setupFunc.ptr ...'
Context::setupBeauty then calls faceProcessorSetFaceLandmarkQuality, setMaxFaces, setFaceProcessorDetectMode, enableVideoHash(true) and registers mlt_face_beauty_register()
per-frame params are pushed from MLT properties by _Z15configFaceParamP12BeautyWapperP16mlt_properties_s (configFaceParam) and _Z12refreshParamP12BeautyWapper...

model_invocation.runtime: same FaceUnity engine (bundle_path passed to setupBeauty)
model_invocation.cadence: per video frame (render cadence of the timeline), with a texture cache (cacheNum/mix_order log fields)
model_invocation.confidence: confirmed (engine + cadence strings), unknown (which bundle the host passes)

postprocess: beauty output texture is mixed back by the Movit node (mix_order log field), then encoded by MediaTranscode
no Java-side mask/landmark handling in this path

lifecycle.fallback: 'BeautyWapper ... dlopen get error: %s' -> filter not registered, video renders without beauty

data_pipelines.name: Makeup styles: item package (makeup_config.json + script.js + PNG layers) composited by MakeUpController

trigger.java_selector: unknown - no Makeup* class in either dex; the photo UI only exposes image_threed / image_red / image_red_type / image_sharpenbrown / image_sharpenbrown_type sliders (m2.a.g0/c0/b0/M/L), auto-set by the smart-style table in IFUCoreBeautyImpl.c

transport.item: bundle zip -> fuCreateItemFromPackage(bytes) -> handle; bound with fuBindItems(faceHandle,[handle])
transport.textures: PNG layers loaded inside the engine by script.js via FaceUnity.LoadTexture(file,0)

preprocess: makeup_config.json keys per group: tex_eyeBrow/makeup_eyeBrow_color/makeup_intensity_eyeBrow, tex_eye*/makeup_eye_color(2), tex_eyeLiner, tex_eyelash, tex_lip_mask_bz/zz/is_two_color/lip_type/lip_blend_weight_type/makeup_lip_color, tex_blusher, tex_highlight, tex_shadow + blend_type_tex_*
brow_warp/brow_warp_type/use_brow_v2/use_eye_v2 select mesh variants from face_warp.json (face_uv_zz/face_uv_bz = 166-vertex lip meshes)

model_invocation.runtime: no TFLite in the makeup path - textures + GLSL only

postprocess: native MakeUpController: makeup_index_v, makeup_current_index, makeupPreprocessLipMask, GetLipMaskTexture, makeupPointsCalc, makeup_distance, makeup_occlusion_type, makeup_lip_color2, makeup_blusher_color2
layer order: eyeBrow -> eye -> eyeLiner -> eyelash -> lip -> blusher -> highlight -> shadow (config order), multiplied by makeup_intensity_* and blend_type_tex_*
occlusion uses the parsing mask (15-class) and lip masks (mask1.png = bz, mask2*.png = zz)

output.consumer: same GLTexturePhotoRenderer path; result lands in the exported Bitmap (CacheData)

lifecycle.init: item created when the style is applied; textures loaded by script.js OnBind
lifecycle.fallback: missing texture -> script.js sets the param to 0 (graceful)

data_pipelines.name: Object removal: mask -> libvis NNF inpaint -> NNF upsample -> composite

trigger.algo: com.miui.mediaeditor.algo.base.BaseAlgorithm dispatch; InpaintAIEngine (BaseAIEngine, FUNC d/e) decides local vs edge-cloud

transport.input: src Bitmap + mask Bitmap (painted strokes; RemoverGestureView Curve/Free/StraightLine/Point elements)
transport.nnf: RemoverNNFData {width,height,index,count, byte[] nnf} - low-res nearest-neighbour field, Parcelable over MemoryFile
transport.libraries: libvis.so + libinpaint.so + libinpaint_jni.so (System.load from com.miui.gallery.editor.photo.app.remover.Inpaint static init)

preprocess: paint strokes are converted to a binary mask bitmap by the remover fragment/gesture view
InpaintProJni.init(long,long,modelDir1,modelDir2) takes two model directories (external NNF files)
nativeInit returns an opaque handle used by inpaint/upsample

model_invocation.runtime: Mi 'vis' NNF engine (libvis.so); libinpaint.so only contains NNF glue (setfree_nnfindex, dstnnf, releaseNNF) - no TFLite/MACE symbols
model_invocation.model: external .nnf file supplied by the dynamic-feature/download path, not in this APK

postprocess: native inpaint returns an integer status + fills RemoverNNFData
Inpaint.upsampleBmpData / InpaintProJni.upsample(handle,bitmap,w,h,NNFData) warps the NNF to full resolution and blends the patch
result bitmap is composited by the remover render fragment into the editor undo stack

lifecycle.init: Inpaint.initialize() once per process; InpaintProJni.init per model directory
lifecycle.fallback: Inpaint.isAvailable()==false when libvis/libinpaint/libinpaint_jni fail to load; InpaintAIEngine falls back to the edge-cloud engine (ManagerStatus/ManagerListConfig.FUNC)
